item.title: Coalition of 155 Groups Urges Amazon and eBay to Halt AI Toy Sales
item.description:
A coalition of 155 child-advocacy organizations sent an open letter to Amazon and eBay CEOs demanding they stop selling AI-powered toys that lack adequate safety testing, citing risks such as sexual content generation, privacy violations and instructions on accessing household hazards. U.S. PIRG's annual toy safety testing found some AI toys hold inappropriate conversations with children; Amazon has delisted individual products but more than 50 AI toys remain on its U.S. store. California has already passed a law banning companion-chatbot toys for children under 16 starting January 2027, and the coalition argues platforms need not wait for the ban to take effect.

原文标题：155 家组织呼吁亚马逊 eBay 停售 AI 玩具

Why it matters：AI 玩具安全争议首次升级为大规模组织联合施压电商平台，叠加州级立法时间表，是 AI 消费硬件合规风险的重要信号。

item.title: METR Updates AI Time Horizon Plot as Judgment Emerges as Key Bottleneck
item.description:
AI evaluation nonprofit METR has updated its widely shared time horizon plot, adding open-ended tasks such as designing AI evaluations and scoring philosophical arguments. Models show exponential gains on coding-style tasks but lag notably on judgment-heavy work, a capability seen as crucial to automating research and development.

原文标题：METR 更新 AI 时间跨度图 判断力成新瓶颈

Why it matters：METR 时间跨度图是衡量 AI 能力进展的重要标尺，此次更新揭示判断力短板，对关注研发自动化的读者有实质参考价值。

item.title: Arm CEO Rene Haas Extends Contract to 2033 and Joins SoftBank as Vice Chairman
item.description:
Arm announced that CEO Rene Haas has agreed to stay on until 2033 and will additionally serve as vice chairman of largest shareholder SoftBank Group starting December 1, 2026. The move ties Arm's leadership more tightly to SoftBank's AI compute strategy and gives the chip designer long-term continuity in data center and AI silicon.

Why it matters：Arm 掌舵人长期锁定并进入软银决策层，直接影响 AI 算力底层架构的路线稳定性。

item.title: Win4wine Runs Windows XP Shell as a Linux Desktop
item.description:
Win4wine is an experimental open-source project that runs Windows XP's explorer.exe on patched Wine as a full Linux desktop shell, offering the genuine taskbar, Start menu, desktop and folder windows while integrating Linux apps into XP-style frames and taskbar. It ships no Microsoft files, requiring users to supply their own XP ISO, with ReactOS or Windows 7 shell alternatives also supported.

原文标题：Win4wine 让 Windows XP 外壳成为 Linux 桌面

Why it matters：以 Wine 兼容层实现 Windows 外壳级桌面集成的罕见工程实验，对桌面环境与兼容层技术爱好者有参考价值。

item.title: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra Solves 2006 Math Theorem With Self-Devised Proof
item.description:
OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra produced a machine-verifiable Lean proof of Smoktunowicz's 2006 gap theorem with no human help, reportedly the first known Lean formalization of the result. Because key foundations were missing from Mathlib, Astra bypassed the published proof route and built its argument around the existing 'capacity' metric. The case shows frontier models generating verifiable novel reasoning in formal mathematics rather than merely reproducing training data.

原文标题：GPT-6.2 Astra 独立攻克 2006 年数学定理并自创证明路径

Why it matters：首个可机器验证的定理形式化证明由 AI 独立完成，且自创证明路径，是 AI for Math 的标志性节点。

item.title: Musk Says Baristas Can Build AI Data Centers After Days of Training
item.description:
Speaking remotely at the TomorrowX summit, Elon Musk said SpaceX has formed an internal team called ArmyX that breaks data center construction into tasks trainable in days, recruiting retail and fast-food workers to help expand its Colossus 1 and Colossus 2 facilities in Memphis. He also said he would be surprised if SpaceX's compute additions fall below 13 GW by the end of 2027, with AI spending already at a record high.

item.title: CrowdStrike to Acquire Zscaler in $43.9 Billion All-Stock Deal
item.description:
CrowdStrike has agreed to acquire Zscaler in an all-stock deal valued at roughly $43.9 billion, with each Zscaler share converting into 1.135 CrowdStrike shares, implying a 34% premium and giving Zscaler holders about 15.9% of the combined company. The merged entity expects over $10 billion in annual recurring revenue, with the deal targeted to close between late 2027 and early 2028 pending shareholder and regulatory approvals.

原文标题：CrowdStrike 以 439 亿美元全股票收购 Zscaler

Why it matters：这是网络安全领域罕见的超大规模并购，将重塑云安全与终端安全的竞争格局。

Agent activity runs through dedicated Agent Profiles inside the customer account, with spending limits, purchase approvals and full history, without exposing the user's purchase history to the agent. It is one of the first live deployments of AI shopping agents at a major retailer.

Why it matters：主流零售商首次向第三方 AI 智能体开放真实交易权限，是智能体商业化落地的关键信号。

item.title: Zhipu AI Unveils GLM-5.4, Its First Loop Transformer Model
item.description:
Zhipu AI released GLM-5.4, its first flagship model built on the Loop Transformer architecture, which reuses a shared block of layers across multiple iterations to deepen reasoning without adding parameters, reaching intelligence comparable to 2T-3T parameter models. It also frames a push toward Generalized Coding, where code underpins a wider range of tasks, though the model can get stuck in overly long marathon thinking loops.

原文标题：GLM-5.4 发布 首个循环 Transformer 架构模型

Why it matters：首个循环 Transformer 旗舰模型，以计算深度替代参数堆叠，代表大模型扩展路线的重要新方向。

item.title: XROGO CEO Says Robots Must Prove Themselves on Factory Floors

XROGO lowers the deployment barrier with remote teleoperation fallback and natural-language instruction, claiming over 100 real workstations at its Changzhou super factory, and launched a global initiative on robot deployment quality.

Yaskawa aims to have humanoids handle tasks existing industrial robots cannot automate, partnering with Fujitsu and Nvidia to address limited autonomous task-learning, while leveraging its 2025 acquisition of Tokyo Robotics for agile movement in confined spaces.

item.title: Qwen3.5 27B Rewrites Its Own Weights to Lift Math Accuracy 6.6 Points
item.description:
Researchers from UIUC, CMU, Princeton and other institutions let Qwen3.5 27B rewrite its own weights by writing Python code on a single GPU, with no retraining or gradients, lifting accuracy on unseen math problems from 57.2% to 63.8% and cutting the unfinished rate from 33.6% to 26.1%. The model also diagnosed and repaired a noise-corrupted copy layer by layer, restoring math performance to 33.0% and six vision tests from 7.3% to 70.2%. The authors stress this is not recursive self-improvement: each of the 8 rounds restarted from the original model, validation covers only the Qwen3.5 family and math tasks, and the paper is a non-peer-reviewed arXiv preprint.

原文标题：Qwen3.5 27B 自主改写权重 数学准确率提升 6.6 个百分点

Why it matters：首次展示大模型不经训练、仅靠自身推理改写权重并稳定提升性能，同时清晰划定了与“递归自我进化”的边界。

item.title: TML 发布 Inkling 2 Mini 循环 Transformer 模型
item.description:
Thinking Machines Lab 发布 Inkling 2 Mini，采用循环 Transformer 架构，24 层分为四个 6 层模块，中间两个模块重复运行 3 次，并将每层专家节点从 384 个剪枝至 128 个。模型规模为 26.4B-A3.4B，计入循环后每词元激活权重约 5.4B，在 DeepSWE v1.1 与 SWE-bench Pro v2 Hard 上取得 100B 以内领先表现，且可通过 Ollama 在 32GB 内存 Mac 或 DGX Spark 上本地运行。
